high_level_description: The image shows two boxes of Estée Lauder skincare products placed on a textured, dark-colored fabric surface, possibly a blanket or a piece of clothing. It prominently displays the Estée Lauder logo at the top, followed by the product name "Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex" in both English and French ("Complexe multi-réparation synchronisée").
